description: I am a specialized education counsellor with 3 years of dedicated experience guiding students toward successful careers in Engineering, MBA, BBA, Diploma in Engineering, Law, Banking and Finance, Cost and Management Accounting, HSC, M.Com, B.Com, B.Sc, and Hotel Management programs. Working across a diverse range of disciplines, I have developed a strong reputation for providing personalized insights and end-to-end admissions support—helping students identify the best-fit institutions, prepare for competitive exams, and navigate the complexities of college selection and career planning.
